improvement_directive: Prove the missing centered converse on the SAME estimand by executing the two-level prior sketched in oeq:unrestricted-centered-converse: put a diffuse one-dimensional prior on the target direction (e.g. a global level shift of mu_{a_0} on B_0) crossed with critical-amplitude sign priors on N_h ~ h^{-d} zero-target Hölder bumps, compute E[Var(theta(P) | H_n)] exactly via the posterior-variance identity, and cancel the law-dependent E_Pi[V*(P)]/n by fixing the variance functions (hence Phi(z)) constant across the prior support so only the Var_P{h_P(X)} vertex varies, using a van Trees / Brown-Low constrained-risk step for the n^{-1-2alpha_d} remainder. If the regression-driven converse resists, first deliver the easier variance-driven (r<s) allocation-sensitivity converse for a fixed law-independent design, which already suffices to bracket R_n on one side.
critique: The note delivers achievability only: every headline statement (thm:explicit-holder-frontier, thm:nuisance-reduction-frontier, thm:smoothness-adaptive-log-free-upper, thm:law-invariant-oracle-allocation-upper) is a one-sided upper bound on R_n, and the sole converse question is left entirely open at oeq:unrestricted-centered-converse — so the advertised 'exact second-order minimax frontier' over the unrestricted estimator class is not established in any regime, not even a two-sided bracket, and the theorem names still carry the word 'frontier' for upper-only results. What is actually new relative to the anchor is (i) removal of the logarithmic slack, achieved by summing expected epoch risks geometrically instead of union-bounding over epochs, and (ii) smoothness adaptation via a dyadic local-polynomial library plus held-out inverse-propensity ERM selection whose log N/m penalty is dominated by m^{-2u/(2u+d)}; both are routine bookkeeping/standard-technique upgrades of an existing construction rather than a new mechanism. The lower bounds that ARE proved (lem:variance-risk-absorption, lem:weighted-mean-holder-risk) are textbook Assouad/bit-testing rates for standalone Hölder mean and variance estimation, not statements about the causal criterion R_n, and thm:nuisance-reduction-frontier only chains an upper bound against them, so it cannot show the nuisance maximum is unavoidable. The sharper mean-only rate of thm:law-invariant-oracle-allocation-upper is conditional on a hypothesis that the two supplied corollaries satisfy only degenerately (v_min = v_max makes the variance a known constant; pointwise singleton support makes the water-filling optimum support-determined), i.e. exactly the cases where the design problem disappears, so it adds little beyond the fixed-smoothness construction. The framing prose is honest about all of this — the TL;DR, interpretation, and honest-scope sections each disclaim any converse — so the shortfall is delivered content, not packaging.
